Guideline CLIN-GL-01 (Acute Bedside Hypoxemia Management):
1. Clinical Threshold: Sustained SpO2 < 90% for >= 3 consecutive minutes represents acute physiological deterioration.
2. Operational SLA: bedside alert latency must be < 10 seconds to notify nursing staff.
3. Immediate Action: Initiate supplemental O2 via nasal cannula (2-4 L/min) or Venturi mask; verify sensor placement and pulse amplitude.
4. Escalation: ICU escalation response time must occur within < 3 minutes if SpO2 fails to recover > 92%.

Guideline CLIN-GL-02 (Post-Discharge Readmission Mitigation):
1. High-Risk Indicators: Patients with >= 2 prior inpatient admissions within 12 months exhibit 3x higher readmission risk (26% vs 8% baseline).
2. Chronic Conditions: Circulatory failure (Heart Failure, AMI) and complex Diabetes carry the highest 30-day readmission vulnerability.
3. Transition of Care: Mandatory clinical touchpoint within 48 hours of discharge and reconciliation of outpatient medications reduces readmissions by 15%.

Guideline CLIN-GL-03 (HIPAA Compliance & Safe Harbor Anonymization):
1. Identification Masking: All Direct identifiers (Name, SSN, MRN) must be masked with SHA-256 cryptographic hashing.
2. Role-Based Access: Restricted analytics roles must only query 100% masked views in Databricks Unity Catalog.
3. Auditability: Delta Lake Time Travel audit logs must be maintained to verify tamper-proof data lineage.

Guideline CLIN-GL-04 (Hemodynamic Deterioration):
1. Tachycardia Criteria: Sustained Heart Rate > 120 bpm at rest accompanied by mean arterial pressure (MAP) drop < 65 mmHg.
2. Escalation: Rapid response team evaluation, serum lactate measurement, and bedside 12-lead ECG.
